definitions: Educational sessions or workshops specifically designed for expectant mothers or new mothers, often focusing on childbirth, infant care, breastfeeding, and postpartum recovery.
A series of instructional meetings for mothers, typically covering topics related to pregnancy, parenting, and child development.
examples: She signed up for Momma Classes to prepare for her first baby.
The hospital offers free Momma Classes every Tuesday.
Many new parents find Momma Classes incredibly helpful.
